name: RA_CUST_RECEIPT_METHODS
description: The RA_CUST_RECEIPT_METHODS table contains a row for each receipt method assigned to a customer or customer site. The primary key for this table is CUST_RECEIPT_METHOD_ID.

columns.name: CUST_RECEIPT_METHOD_ID
columns.description: Uniquely identifies the customer receipt method

columns.name: CUSTOMER_ID
columns.description: Customer account identifier.

columns.name: RECEIPT_METHOD_ID
columns.description: Identifies the receipt method identifier

columns.name: PRIMARY_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates if customer receipt method is primary. Y for Yes, N otherwise.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: PROGRAM_APPLICATION_ID
columns.description: Concurrent Program who column - application id of the program that last updated this row (foreign key to FND_APPLICATION.APPLICATION_ID).

columns.name: PROGRAM_ID
columns.description: Concurrent Program who column - program id of the program that last updated this row (foreign key to FND_CONCURRENT_PROGRAM.CONCURRENT_PROGRAM_ID).

columns.name: PROGRAM_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Concurrent Program who column - date when a program last updated this row).

columns.name: SITE_USE_ID
columns.description: Identifies the site use

columns.name: START_DATE
columns.description: Start date of the customer receipt methods

columns.name: END_DATE
columns.description: End date of the customer receipt methods
